acceptance.given: The replay Matrix is assembled or verified from six Matrix Case records, each with distinct inputs and separated Stable and Candidate state, and the implementation must additionally bind a distinct fixture or state transition to every case.

oracle.expected: The matrix verification records six independently owned fixture or state-transition bindings, one for each Matrix Case, and rejects any case whose fixture or state-transition identity is reused by another case.
forbidden: A Matrix Case reuses another case's fixture or state transition.
Distinct labels or hashes alone establish case distinction.
oracle.observable: A runtime matrix-verification result contains six per-case fixture/state-transition ownership observations and reports rejection when any ownership identity is duplicated.

acceptance.then: When the replay Matrix is assembled or verified, execute the matrix ownership check and inspect its per-case ownership observations before accepting the result.
acceptance.when: The replay Matrix is assembled or verified.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the matrix ownership check against a controlled six-case matrix in which two Matrix Cases intentionally reference the same fixture or state-transition identity; the behavior test must produce an unsuccessful terminal result.

Run the matrix ownership check against six cases with distinct labels or hashes but no independently owned fixture or state-transition bindings; the verification must reject the matrix rather than infer ownership from labels or hashes.

affected_subjects: six replay Matrix Cases: valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap
slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend matrix assembly and verification so each of the six Matrix Cases carries an independently owned fixture or state-transition binding in addition to distinct inputs and separated Stable/Candidate state; duplicate ownership and label/hash-only distinctions become unsuccessful results.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt and Matrix Case schemas and terminal categories; reject only matrices lacking independent per-case fixture/state-transition ownership, without rewriting historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix assembly changes from recording case labels/inputs alone to recording and validating a unique fixture or state-transition identity for every case before aggregate evaluation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The matrix result is successful only if all six Matrix Cases execute with distinct inputs, separated Stable/Candidate state, and independently owned fixture or state-transition bindings; any duplicate binding, missing binding, or label/hash-only distinction yields an unsuccessful terminal result.
